name: @hasna/statusline
description: Tiny composable statusline CLI for AI coding agents — pre-built toggleable segments for Claude Code, with a provider model for others

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/cli.ts src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/mcp/index.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scan:artifact
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.scan:artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/statusline-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.11.1 artifact-scan statusline-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/statusline-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc
